name: Mailchimp
label: Mailchimp Marketing API 3.0 — audiences, tags, campaigns (not Mandrill)
description: Official Mailchimp Marketing API 3.0 at https://{dc}.api.mailchimp.com/3.0/. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Authorization: Bearer {api_key}. Mandrill transactional is not this node. subscriber_hash = MD5(lowercase email); pass the hash. trigger.listen is ingress. Consent required before status=subscribed. Customer owns the Mailchimp account. api_key is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put api_key here. dc and list_id required for member ops. subscriber_hash is MD5 of lowercase email. Example: {"operation":"member.list","list_id":"abc"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT Marketing API verbs including trigger.listen.

schema.label: dc
schema.description: Mailchimp data center from the API key suffix. Path {dc}.api.mailchimp.com. Also config. Example: us21. All HTTP operations.

schema.label: list_id
schema.description: Audience list id. Path for member.* ; campaign.create wires it to recipients.list_id. Example: a1b2c3d4e5.

schema.label: subscriber_hash
schema.description: MD5 of the lowercase email. Path for member.get/update/delete/tags.

schema.label: email_address
schema.description: Member email for member.create / member.update. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Member status. EXACT: subscribed | pending | unsubscribed | cleaned. member.create required; also member.list filter and member.update.

schema.label: merge_fields
schema.description: Merge-field map (FNAME, LNAME, …) for member.create / member.update.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Tags for member.create (strings) or memberTag.add/remove ([{name, status}]).

schema.label: language
schema.description: ISO language for member.create / member.update. Example: en.

schema.label: ip_signup
schema.description: Signup IP for member.create. Official ip_signup.

schema.label: count
schema.description: Page size for member.list, campaign.list, template.list. Example: 50.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Offset for list operations. Example: 0.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Comma-separated response fields for member.list.

schema.label: campaign_id
schema.description: Campaign id for get/send/replicate/resend/delete.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Campaign type for campaign.create / campaign.list. EXACT: regular | plaintext | absplit | rss | variate. Example: regular.

schema.label: recipients
schema.description: Campaign recipients envelope escape hatch for campaign.create. Purpose field list_id merges as recipients.list_id via bodyMap. Example: {"segment_opts":{"saved_segment_id":1}}.

schema.label: settings
schema.description: Campaign settings envelope escape hatch for campaign.create. Purpose fields subject_line/from_name/reply_to/title/template_id merge as settings.* via bodyMap. Example: {"auto_footer":true}.

schema.label: subject_line
schema.description: Campaign subject. Wired to settings.subject_line on campaign.create.

schema.label: from_name
schema.description: From name. Wired to settings.from_name on campaign.create.

schema.label: reply_to
schema.description: Reply-To address. Wired to settings.reply_to on campaign.create.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Internal campaign title. Wired to settings.title on campaign.create.

schema.label: template_id
schema.description: Template id. Wired to settings.template_id on campaign.create.

schema.label: __omit
schema.description: Placeholder so action POSTs (campaign.send / replicate / resendNonOpeners) send an empty JSON object. Leave blank.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Do not log emails, phones, or secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT Marketing API verbs.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Marketing API key (StudioQuack secret), form key-usX. Sent as Authorization: Bearer {api_key}. Never log or place on INPUT. Not a Mandrill key.

configurationParameters.label: Data center
configurationParameters.description: Host prefix us1…usX matching the API key suffix. Required for every call.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Provider cap 120 s.
